description: Xeon Phi 5110P (60 cores, 1.053 GHz, 8 GB GDDR5, 320 GB/s peak). Card constants are Intel's published specification. Core timing in cycles is inherited from core-x100-measured (measured on the project's 7120-class card; same core design, not re-measured on a 5110P). L2 and memory latency are published measurements on 5100-series or similar systems (R06, R07, R08). The project's '--profile 5100' runs limit threads and memory on the 7120 card; they are not 5110P measurements.

calibration.statement: Core timing is transferred from the 7120-class card; L2 and memory latency are literature values from other samples; nothing was measured on a 5110P by this project. Every result is an unvalidated scenario estimate for this card.

card.model.source: Intel product specification (ark.intel.com, Xeon Phi Coprocessor 5110P)

card.usable_cores.source: one core reserved for the card OS in the usual native configuration; not measured

latency.memory.source: R06 §5.1.1 (318-346 cycles at 1 GHz on an engineering sample); R08 ~300 cycles at 1.1 GHz

latency.remote_l2_line_ns.source: R06 §5.1.2 (about 243 cycles at 1 GHz, sd 32); R08 ~275 ns

latency.branch_mispredict_penalty.source: not measured on a 5110P by any imported source

card.sustained_bandwidth_gbs.source: R09 reports pre-production STREAM figures only; not imported

memory.core_service_cycles_per_line.source: 7120-class card: 20 cycles per line at 1.238 GHz = 16.2 ns, converted at 1.053 GHz; not measured on a 5110P
